sources.title: Quickstart - Gemma Documentation
sources.snippet: The Gemma model weights are supported by developer tools that promote innovation, collaboration, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence (AI). The latest in the Gemma family is Gemma 4 featuring multimodal (text, image, audio) inputs.

sources.title: ‎Google Gemini
sources.snippet: Get assistance with writing, planning, learning, and more from Google AI.

sources.title: Gemma 4 — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 models undergo the same rigorous infrastructure security protocols as our proprietary models. By choosing Gemma 4, enterprises and sovereign organizations gain a trusted, transparent foundation that delivers state-of-the-art capabilities while meeting the highest standards for security and reliability.

sources.title: Introducing Gemma 4 12B - The Keyword
sources.snippet: An overview of Gemma 4 12B, a model designed to bring high-performance multimodal intelligence directly to your laptop.

sources.title: Gemma 4 12B: The Developer Guide - Google Developers Blog
sources.snippet: Meet Gemma 4 12B: the first medium-sized, encoder-free multimodal model capable of natively ingesting audio and video. Ideal for local AI development with 16GB VRAM, Hugging Face integrations, and drop-in local API servers.
